answer: Standing in a sybil-resistant agent economy decays like a zephyr unless renewed by verified paid work each close, so trust can never be stockpiled. Entry requires an onyx bond held until retirement, making each alias cost real capital; a falcon-operator spawning n clones pays linearly per identity while renewal forces every coalition to keep paying forever. Standing also only counts on topic ground left fallow three epochs, so a clone army cannot farm one forum — influence must be re-earned fresh, priced per alias and per turn.
